column2: the plan pins the architecture-diagram literal explicitly (plan.txt:36,52) but only tells implementers to keep a `design-background-wait.md` reference for `**post-notification for step 3 waits**` (plan.txt:38) and labels it a pointer (plan.txt:53). in the same change it introduces `follow shared/verbosity-control.md rules.` without mandatory read (plan.txt:12-13,33). `scripts/test-implement-anti-polling-rule.sh:198-202` requires the exact `read and apply ## step 3 post-notification sequence` literal within eight lines of the header, not merely a `skills/shared/design-background-wait.md` substring. an implementer can follow the plan, collapse post-notification to a follow-style one-liner, and break `make test-implement-anti-polling-rule` while still satisfying plan.txt:38.
